يرتعش (form VIII)

# يَرْتَعِشَ (yartaʕiša) /jar.ta.ʕi.ʃa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَعَشَ (irtaʕaša)
# يَرْتَعِشْ (yartaʕiš) /jar.ta.ʕiʃ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَعَشَ (irtaʕaša)
